opening.argument: The reported result is presented as a striking 110% return on $2,000 of crypto-options capital, with more than $2,000 described as profit. That promotional claim is paired with a direct recommendation to set aside funds for options trading and open a Delta Exchange account through the link in the description. The account-opening overlay and options order panel reinforce that invitation, showing the named platform, leverage, filled orders, and premium received. The speaker also describes moving funds into the trading account and leverage reaching 100x. Disclosures that the trade involved high risk and a small amount of capital do not remove the high-return promotion or the associated direction to fund and trade.
